notes.title: Sales Reach 7K! First Week Summary!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I'm Sunny, the producer of "Fantasy Cao Cao 2". This is the first game our studio has launched, and it's the second game I've personally developed. In the just-concluded first week of its release, "Fantasy Cao Cao 2" has surpassed "Fantasy Cao Cao 1" in both sales and reputation. Regarding reputation, it currently has an 88% excellent rating. In terms of sales, we've sold 7,000 copies of the main game and 4,500 DLCs. With continued sales, breaking 10,000 is just a matter of time.

To be honest, due to the poor reception of the first game, "Fantasy Cao Cao 2" was not initially seen favorably when we started the project. But that's exactly why I was determined to make this sequel, to give a better game to those who supported us before. Step by step, I hope to gain more experience in game production and continue to make better games.

Therefore, I am very satisfied with the current achievements. It shows that most players recognize and appreciate the quality and improvement of the game. Here, I want to thank all the players for their love and support!

Of course, this does not mean that "Fantasy Cao Cao 2" is already perfect. Over the past week, I have been continuously fixing bugs and optimizing features. You can see the details in the Steam update log. In the coming period, we will continue to update and improve everyone's gaming experience, so stay tuned.

Also, many friends have been asking if I've recouped my investment and if I have enough money to make the next game. Well, first of all, we have recouped about half of the investment. I am relatively optimistic, with continued long-term sales on Steam, plus overseas mobile platforms and domestic Taptap sponsorship for beta testing... Oh right, a few days ago, a Korean PC game platform wanted to sign an exclusive deal for the Korean version of my game. I believe that with all these channels combined, it's hopeful that we will break even~~~

Regarding the next project, it's already underway. It's not "Fantasy Cao Cao 3", but a new IP. The art work for the new IP has already started, and we will soon add 4 new characters for free in a skin package DLC for "Fantasy Cao Cao 2". I believe then everyone will guess what the next work is about.

OK, this is just a brief summary. If you want to know more, feel free to tell me in the comments section.

notes.content:

Hello everyone, I'm Sunny. It's been a while since we last chatted. Today, I have two important announcements to make!

First and foremost, I am thrilled to announce that our game studio, Sunny Games, has signed a publishing deal for our Chinese-style pigeon-themed card game, "Fantasy Cao Cao Chronicles 2"! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41981782/e421d22910b55297b0d6aeea2fbde12375d75c1b.jpg[/img]

Not only have we received an advance payment, but we have also recovered a small portion of the production costs. Additionally, we have gained a partner for game promotion.

The publishing brand we have signed with is Love Story Project, a subsidiary of Yamayuri. It is commonly referred to as LSP for short. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41981782/6e9633df4dc6d7b3066e3af484737937acb4e818.jpg[/img]

Yamayuri, the creator of the million-selling heartwarming youth romance game "Tricolor Love," established LSP with a passion for and dedication to visual novel games. Last year, LSP published the popular yuri game "Wandering Streets."

True to LSP's reputation, the first thing they did after signing with us was to collaborate with other game development teams and create crossover skins. As you can see in the video's cover, on the right side, we have the original skin of Hattori Hanzo, lively and playful. On the left side, we have the alluring demon Hattori Hanzo skin after the crossover, equally adorable. And this pose reminds me of Jolin Tsai...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41981782/09eede29c7b7e1e534118d64febfa004e0323ed1.jpg[/img]
According to reliable information from LSP, there will be approximately 5 to 7 crossover skins like this...

Therefore, I believe the combination of "Fantasy Cao Cao Chronicles 2" and LSP will create a wonderful chemical reaction.

And now, it's time for the Steam Next Fest!

will have its first public gameplay demo on the Steam platform on June 19th. It's worth mentioning that during the recently concluded WEGAME Playtesting Festival, over 2000 players participated and showed their support. We received an anticipation score of 8.7, which briefly placed us on the reputation charts.

Admittedly, the game still has room for improvement, and we need the continuous support and feedback from players. After a year and a half, we are meeting again on the Steam platform, filled with anticipation and a mix of excitement and anxiety. We welcome everyone to leave their opinions and suggestions in the community or groups. After the Next Fest, we will select strategy experts and outstanding feedback contributors and present them with a special "Fantasy Cao Cao Chronicles 2" custom-made Left Immortal mousepad. With eager eyes, we look forward to cultivating alongside you in the game. Its soft and dense texture will provide your wrists with intimate protection!
